opening.argument: The presentation ties compensation to package purchases throughout a network: it lists direct-sales, network and generational matching bonuses, and describes a $500 bonus when someone elsewhere in the network buys a package. It also tells viewers they’ll double their money and recommends partnering with the team today. Alongside that recruitment-based pitch, the speaker projects a OneCoin price range from 50 cents to around $2.50 and presents profit potential from buying at approximately $0.50. These are extraordinary account-growth and income claims used to promote joining and purchasing, yet the cited material does not substantiate those assurances.
